question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Mr. Pearson interrupted their harmless ______ and reminded them of the seriousness of the situation.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chatter**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **Chatter** is a verb which means to speak rapidly or in depth about insignificant topics.
 
• *Example* : My teacher nicknamed me as **chatter** box.
 
• **Verbs** are words that describe an action, an occurrence, or a state of being (exist).</li&g
